panels.description: Lifecycle health derived only from durable trading process state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.enabled
      AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
      AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
  ) AS "Active Processes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.enabled
      AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
      AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)<now()-interval '2 minutes'
  ) AS "Stale Active Processes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.status='failed' AND p.updated_at>=now()-interval '24 hours'
  ) AS "Failures 24h"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.status <> 'completed';

panels.title: Realtime Process Health

panels.description: One bar per filled, officially resolved paper entry for the selected process. Right/green means an UP forecast; left/red means DOWN. Bar length and its inline value show the stored forecast probability. Each category label shows the UTC decision time and signed net realized PnL after entry fees. This uses the durable process ID and official market outcome only—never an experiment.

targets.rawSql:
WITH resolved_decisions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    d.decision_at,
    d.decision_id,
    d.process_id,
    d.outcome AS forecast_outcome,
    d.fair_probability,
    m.official_outcome,
    m.official_winning_token_id,
    (d.metadata#>>'{paper_order_plan,orders,0,request,client_order_id}')::uuid AS client_order_id
  FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m
    ON m.market_id=d.market_id
  WHERE d.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid
    AND d.execution_mode='paper'
    AND d.action='buy'
    AND d.status='filled'
    AND d.outcome IN ('up','down')
    AND d.fair_probability BETWEEN 0 AND 1
    AND d.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND m.official_outcome IN ('up','down')
    AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND d.metadata#>>'{paper_order_plan,orders,0,request,client_order_id}' IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY d.decision_at DESC
  LIMIT 20
), resolved_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    d.decision_at,
    d.decision_id,
    d.forecast_outcome,
    d.official_outcome,
    d.fair_probability,
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN o.token_id=d.official_winning_token_id THEN f.size ELSE 0::numeric END
      -f.price*f.size-f.fee
    )::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM resolved_decisions d
  JOIN polymarket.orders o
    ON o.client_order_id=d.client_order_id
   AND o.process_id=d.process_id
  JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id=o.order_id
   AND f.process_id=o.process_id
   AND f.source='paper'
  GROUP BY d.decision_at,d.decision_id,d.forecast_outcome,d.official_outcome,d.fair_probability
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN forecast_outcome=official_outcome THEN '✅ ' ELSE '❌ ' END||
  to_char(decision_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','MM-DD HH24:MI')||' UTC - '||
  CASE
    WHEN net_pnl>0 THEN '+'||chr(36)||to_char(net_pnl,'FM999999990.00')
    WHEN net_pnl<0 THEN '-'||chr(36)||to_char(abs(net_pnl),'FM999999990.00')
    ELSE chr(36)||'0.00'
  END AS "Decision",
  (CASE WHEN forecast_outcome='up' THEN fair_probability ELSE -fair_probability END)::double precision
    AS "Forecast confidence"
FROM resolved_entries
ORDER BY decision_at DESC;

panels.title: Resolved Entry Forecasts vs Official Outcome

panels.description: Real-time countdown for the canonical BTC five-minute market observed by every active trading process. Grafana Live updates this panel every second independently of the dashboard's global refresh timer. Waiting indicates no active process, market discovery, or disagreement between process feeds.
panels.title: 5-Minute Market Countdown

panels.description: Aggregate fresh unrealized PnL for the current PnL scope, using only current scheduled-market entries. All processes sums across processes. When entries exist but no bid is fresh within two seconds, PnL displays No fresh mark instead of $0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT now() AS at
), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m'
    AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.status <> 'completed'
), current_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.process_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.token_id,
    SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
    SUM(f.price * f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,
    SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees
  FROM selected_process p
  JOIN polymarket.orders o USING (process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id = o.order_id
   AND f.process_id = o.process_id
   AND f.source = 'paper'
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id = o.market_id
  CROSS JOIN clock c
  WHERE m.window_start <= c.at
    AND m.window_end > c.at
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY o.process_id, o.order_id, o.token_id
), marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*, mark.best_bid
  FROM current_entries e
  CROSS JOIN clock c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT checkpoint.best_bid
    FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints checkpoint
    WHERE checkpoint.token_id = e.token_id
      AND checkpoint.integrity_status = 'ok'
      AND checkpoint.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND checkpoint.source_timestamp BETWEEN c.at - interval '2 seconds' AND c.at + interval '1 second'
      AND checkpoint.received_at BETWEEN c.at - interval '2 seconds' AND c.at
    ORDER BY checkpoint.source_timestamp DESC, checkpoint.received_at DESC, checkpoint.ingest_sequence DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0::numeric
    WHEN COUNT(best_bid) = 0 THEN NULL::numeric
    ELSE SUM(filled_size * best_bid - entry_cost - entry_fees)
      FILTER (WHERE best_bid IS NOT NULL)
  END::double precision AS "Current Fresh Unrealized PnL",
  COUNT(*) AS "Current Market Entry Orders"
FROM marked;

panels.title: Current Fresh Unrealized PnL

panels.description: Cumulative lifetime net realized PnL for the current PnL scope, derived from process-owned paper fills and official outcomes. Selected process uses the Trading process selection; All processes renders one series per process.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts,$__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_bin('5 minutes',from_ts,timestamptz '1970-01-01'),
    to_ts,interval '5 minutes'
  ) AS time FROM bounds
  UNION SELECT to_ts FROM bounds
), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.created_at
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m'
    AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.status <> 'completed'
), realized AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.process_id,m.official_resolution_received_at AS realized_at,
         (CASE WHEN o.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.size ELSE 0::numeric END
          -f.price*f.size-f.fee)::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM polymarket.fills f
  JOIN polymarket.orders o
    ON o.order_id=f.order_id AND o.process_id=f.process_id
  JOIN selected_process p ON p.process_id=f.process_id
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=o.market_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE f.source='paper'
    AND m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at<=b.to_ts
)
SELECT b.time,p.name||' ['||left(p.process_id::text,8)||']' AS metric,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.net_pnl) FILTER(WHERE r.realized_at<=b.time),0)::double precision AS value
FROM selected_process p
JOIN buckets b ON b.time>=p.created_at
LEFT JOIN realized r ON r.process_id=p.process_id AND r.realized_at<=b.time
GROUP BY b.time,p.process_id,p.name
ORDER BY b.time,metric;

panels.title: Cumulative Net Realized PnL by Process

panels.description: Aggregate lifetime net realized PnL for the current PnL scope. All processes sums across processes; processes without resolved fills contribute zero. Values use process-owned paper fills and official outcomes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN m.market_id IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
        ELSE
          CASE WHEN o.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.size ELSE 0::numeric END
          -f.price*f.size-f.fee
      END
    ),
    0::numeric
  )::double precision AS "Lifetime Net Realized PnL"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
LEFT JOIN polymarket.fills f
  ON f.process_id=p.process_id
 AND f.source='paper'
LEFT JOIN polymarket.orders o
  ON o.order_id=f.order_id
 AND o.process_id=f.process_id
LEFT JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m
  ON m.market_id=o.market_id
 AND m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL
 AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
 AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
  AND p.process_type='btc_5m'
  AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.status <> 'completed';

panels.title: Lifetime Net Realized PnL

panels.description: Live status of the shared Polymarket CLOB websocket. A positive active connection epoch maps to Connected; zero or no value means there is no current active connection. This is a global shared-feed signal, independent of the selected trading process.
panels.title: CLOB Active Connection

panels.description: Most recent ping/pong round-trip time for the active Polymarket CLOB websocket. This is a live transport-latency signal; a missing value means there is no active socket to measure.
panels.title: CLOB Pong RTT

panels.description: Current consecutive CLOB websocket connection failures. Zero is normal; a non-zero value indicates the active connection/recovery cycle is failing repeatedly.
panels.title: CLOB Consecutive Failures

panels.description: PnL, runtime, and settlement status for the current PnL scope, with one row per process. Selected process uses the Trading process selection. Current-market entries and entries awaiting official settlement are intentionally separate; only current-market entries contribute to fresh unrealized PnL. Total PnL is unavailable while an entry is unpriced or awaits official settlement.

matcher.options: /^(Current Market Entries|Freshly Priced Current Entries|Unpriced Current Entries|Awaiting Official Settlement)$/

targets.rawSql:
WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT now() AS at
), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.status,p.enabled,p.config,p.created_at,p.updated_at,p.heartbeat_at,p.stopped_at
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m'
    AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.status <> 'completed'
), filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,o.market_id,
         MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,
         SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees
  FROM polymarket.orders o
  JOIN selected_process p USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source='paper'
  GROUP BY o.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,o.market_id
), fill_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,COUNT(*) AS filled_orders,
         SUM(entry_cost)::numeric AS entry_notional,
         SUM(entry_fees)::numeric AS entry_fees,
         MAX(filled_at) AS last_fill_at
  FROM filled_orders GROUP BY process_id
), resolved_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.process_id,COUNT(*) AS resolved_positions,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END
             -f.entry_cost)::numeric AS gross_realized_pnl,
         SUM(f.entry_fees)::numeric AS realized_fees,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END
             -f.entry_cost-f.entry_fees)::numeric AS realized_pnl,
         MAX(m.official_resolution_received_at) AS last_resolution_at
  FROM filled_orders f
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
  WHERE m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY f.process_id
), unresolved_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.*,m.window_start,m.window_end
  FROM filled_orders f
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
  WHERE m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
), current_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT u.*
  FROM unresolved_entries u
  CROSS JOIN clock c
  WHERE u.window_start<=c.at
    AND u.window_end>c.at
), pending_settlements AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT u.process_id,
         COUNT(*) AS awaiting_official_settlement,
         MIN(u.window_end) AS oldest_pending_settlement_at
  FROM unresolved_entries u
  CROSS JOIN clock c
  WHERE u.window_end<=c.at
  GROUP BY u.process_id
), marked_current AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,mark.best_bid,mark.source_timestamp AS mark_at
  FROM current_entries e
  CROSS JOIN clock c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT checkpoint.best_bid,checkpoint.source_timestamp
    FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints checkpoint
    WHERE checkpoint.token_id=e.token_id
      AND checkpoint.integrity_status='ok'
      AND checkpoint.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND checkpoint.source_timestamp BETWEEN c.at-interval '2 seconds' AND c.at+interval '1 second'
      AND checkpoint.received_at BETWEEN c.at-interval '2 seconds' AND c.at
    ORDER BY checkpoint.source_timestamp DESC,checkpoint.received_at DESC,checkpoint.ingest_sequence DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
), current_pnl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,
         COUNT(*) AS current_market_entries,
         COUNT(best_bid) AS current_freshly_priced,
         COUNT(*)-COUNT(best_bid) AS current_unpriced_entries,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0::numeric
              WHEN COUNT(best_bid)=0 THEN NULL::numeric
              ELSE SUM(filled_size*best_bid-entry_cost-entry_fees)
                FILTER(WHERE best_bid IS NOT NULL) END::numeric AS current_fresh_unrealized_pnl,
         MAX(mark_at) AS latest_mark_at
  FROM marked_current
  GROUP BY process_id
), metrics AS (
  SELECT p.*,COALESCE(f.filled_orders,0) AS filled_orders,
         COALESCE(r.resolved_positions,0) AS resolved_positions,
         COALESCE(x.current_market_entries,0) AS current_market_entries,
         COALESCE(x.current_freshly_priced,0) AS current_freshly_priced,
         COALESCE(x.current_unpriced_entries,0) AS current_unpriced_entries,
         COALESCE(s.awaiting_official_settlement,0) AS awaiting_official_settlement,
         CASE WHEN s.oldest_pending_settlement_at IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE EXTRACT(epoch FROM c.at-s.oldest_pending_settlement_at)::bigint END
           AS oldest_pending_settlement_age_seconds,
         COALESCE(r.gross_realized_pnl,0)::numeric AS gross_realized_pnl,
         COALESCE(r.realized_fees,0)::numeric AS realized_fees,
         COALESCE(r.realized_pnl,0)::numeric AS realized_pnl,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.current_market_entries,0)=0 THEN 0::numeric
              ELSE x.current_fresh_unrealized_pnl END::numeric AS current_fresh_unrealized_pnl,
         x.latest_mark_at,
         GREATEST(p.updated_at,COALESCE(f.last_fill_at,p.updated_at),
           COALESCE(r.last_resolution_at,p.updated_at),COALESCE(x.latest_mark_at,p.updated_at)) AS last_updated,
         CASE WHEN p.config#>>'{raw,btc_realtime_paper,paper,starting_collateral_usd}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN (p.config#>>'{raw,btc_realtime_paper,paper,starting_collateral_usd}')::numeric END AS starting_collateral
  FROM selected_process p
  CROSS JOIN clock c
  LEFT JOIN fill_stats f USING(process_id)
  LEFT JOIN resolved_stats r USING(process_id)
  LEFT JOIN current_pnl x USING(process_id)
  LEFT JOIN pending_settlements s USING(process_id)
), presentation AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN awaiting_official_settlement>0 OR current_unpriced_entries>0 THEN NULL::numeric
              ELSE realized_pnl+COALESCE(current_fresh_unrealized_pnl,0)::numeric END AS total_pnl
  FROM metrics
)
SELECT name AS "Process",
       left(process_id::text,8) AS "Process ID",
       status AS "Status",
       current_market_entries AS "Current Market Entries",
       awaiting_official_settlement AS "Awaiting Official Settlement",
       current_fresh_unrealized_pnl::double precision AS "Current Fresh Unrealized PnL",
       total_pnl::double precision AS "Total PnL",
       oldest_pending_settlement_age_seconds AS "Oldest Pending Settlement Age",
       current_freshly_priced AS "Freshly Priced Current Entries",
       current_unpriced_entries AS "Unpriced Current Entries",
       realized_pnl::double precision AS "Lifetime Net Realized PnL",
       gross_realized_pnl::double precision AS "Gross Realized PnL",
       realized_fees::double precision AS "Realized Fees",
       CASE WHEN starting_collateral>0 AND total_pnl IS NOT NULL
            THEN (total_pnl/starting_collateral)::double precision END AS "ROI",
       enabled AS "Enabled",
       heartbeat_at AS "Last Heartbeat",
       EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()-COALESCE(heartbeat_at,updated_at))::bigint AS "Heartbeat Age",
       last_updated AS "Last Updated",
       filled_orders AS "Filled Orders",
       resolved_positions AS "Resolved Positions"
FROM presentation
ORDER BY last_updated DESC,name;

panels.title: Process PnL, Runtime, and Settlement Status

panels.description: Lifetime net realized PnL after paper-fill fees, with one bar for every BTC 5-minute realtime-paper trading process. Only officially resolved outcomes contribute; processes without resolved fills remain visible at zero. This fleet-wide view is intentionally independent of the PnL scope, Trading process, and dashboard time-range selectors.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eligible_processes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.created_at
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE p.process_type='btc_5m'
    AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.status <> 'completed'
), realized_by_process AS (
  SELECT
    o.process_id,
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN o.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.size ELSE 0::numeric END
      -f.price*f.size-f.fee
    )::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM eligible_processes p
  JOIN polymarket.orders o
    ON o.process_id=p.process_id
   AND o.side='buy'
  JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id=o.order_id
   AND f.process_id=o.process_id
   AND f.token_id=o.token_id
   AND f.source='paper'
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m
    ON m.market_id=o.market_id
  WHERE m.official_outcome IN ('up','down')
    AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.process_id
)
SELECT
  p.name||' ['||left(p.process_id::text,8)||']' AS "Process",
  COALESCE(r.net_pnl,0::numeric)::double precision AS "Lifetime Net Realized PnL"
FROM eligible_processes p
LEFT JOIN realized_by_process r USING(process_id)
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.net_pnl,0::numeric) DESC,p.created_at DESC,p.process_id;

panels.title: Lifetime Net Realized PnL by Trading Process

panels.description: Point-in-time Binance and Chainlink prices seen by the selected trading process, expressed as basis-point movement from the current five-minute Chainlink opening price. Filled entries are marked by direction and official outcome. Gaps are intentional: they separate five-minute markets and exclude non-ready, missing, stale, or paused observations.

targets.rawSql:
WITH settings AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 hours' THEN interval '1 second'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '12 hours' THEN interval '3 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 days' THEN interval '10 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '7 days' THEN interval '30 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '30 days' THEN interval '2 minutes'
    ELSE interval '10 minutes'
  END AS bucket_width
), source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id,s.feature_as_of,s.window_start,s.market_id,
         s.chainlink_gap_bps::double precision AS chainlink_move_bps,
         (10000.0*(s.binance_price/s.chainlink_open_price-1))::double precision AS binance_move_bps
  FROM polymarket.btc_feature_snapshots s
  WHERE s.features->>'process_id'=${process_id:sqlstring}
    AND s.window_start BETWEEN date_bin('5 minutes',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,timestamptz '1970-01-01')-interval '5 minutes'
                           AND date_bin('5 minutes',$__timeTo()::timestamptz,timestamptz '1970-01-01')
    AND s.feature_as_of BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND s.readiness_status='ready'
    AND s.chainlink_price>0 AND s.chainlink_open_price>0 AND s.binance_price>0
), sampled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT date_bin(cfg.bucket_width,s.feature_as_of,s.window_start) AS time,s.market_id,
         MIN(s.window_start) AS window_start,
         last(s.chainlink_move_bps,s.feature_as_of) AS chainlink_move_bps,
         last(s.binance_move_bps,s.feature_as_of) AS binance_move_bps
  FROM source s CROSS JOIN settings cfg
  GROUP BY 1,s.market_id
), markets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT market_id,window_start FROM source
), series AS (
  SELECT time,'Chainlink vs 5m open'::text AS metric,chainlink_move_bps AS value FROM sampled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time,'Binance vs 5m open',binance_move_bps FROM sampled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time,'Chainlink 5m open / resolution',0::double precision FROM sampled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Chainlink vs 5m open',NULL::double precision FROM markets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Binance vs 5m open',NULL::double precision FROM markets
), markers AS (
  SELECT s.feature_as_of AS time,
         CASE
           WHEN m.official_winning_token_id IS NULL THEN 'Entry OPEN '
           WHEN d.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN 'Entry WIN '
           ELSE 'Entry LOSS '
         END||upper(d.outcome) AS metric,
         s.chainlink_move_bps AS value
  FROM source s
  JOIN polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d
    ON d.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id AND d.decision_at=s.feature_as_of
   AND d.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid
   AND d.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=s.market_id
  WHERE d.action='buy' AND d.status='filled'
)
SELECT time,metric,value FROM series
UNION ALL
SELECT time,metric,value FROM markers
ORDER BY time,metric;

panels.title: Binance–Chainlink Movement and Filled Entries

panels.description: Normalized basis is the current Binance/Chainlink basis minus its recent neutral median. Positive convergence speed means the absolute lead is shrinking without crossing; negative values mean it is expanding. Calculations use only prior observations, are partitioned by five-minute market, and never bridge missing data or process pauses.

targets.rawSql:
WITH settings AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 hours' THEN interval '1 second'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '12 hours' THEN interval '3 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 days' THEN interval '10 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '7 days' THEN interval '30 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '30 days' THEN interval '2 minutes'
    ELSE interval '10 minutes'
  END AS bucket_width
), source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.feature_as_of,s.window_start,s.market_id,s.basis_bps::double precision AS basis_bps
  FROM polymarket.btc_feature_snapshots s
  WHERE s.features->>'process_id'=${process_id:sqlstring}
    AND s.feature_as_of BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND s.readiness_status='ready'
    AND s.chainlink_price>0 AND s.chainlink_open_price>0 AND s.binance_price>0
), sampled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT date_bin(cfg.bucket_width,s.feature_as_of,s.window_start) AS time,s.market_id,
         MIN(s.window_start) AS window_start,
         last(s.basis_bps,s.feature_as_of) AS basis_bps,
         MAX(cfg.bucket_width) AS bucket_width
  FROM source s CROSS JOIN settings cfg
  GROUP BY 1,s.market_id
), lagged AS (
  SELECT *,
         lag(time) OVER(PARTITION BY market_id ORDER BY time) AS previous_time,
         lag(basis_bps) OVER(PARTITION BY market_id ORDER BY time) AS previous_basis
  FROM sampled
), metrics AS (
  SELECT time,market_id,window_start,basis_bps,
         CASE
           WHEN previous_time IS NULL
             OR time-previous_time>bucket_width*2
             OR previous_basis IS NULL
             OR sign(previous_basis)=0
             OR sign(basis_bps)<>sign(previous_basis)
           THEN NULL
           ELSE (abs(previous_basis)-abs(basis_bps))
                /NULLIF(EXTRACT(epoch FROM time-previous_time),0)
         END AS convergence_speed
  FROM lagged
), markets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT market_id,window_start FROM source
), series AS (
  SELECT time,'Normalized Binance lead'::text AS metric,basis_bps AS value FROM metrics
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time,'Convergence speed',convergence_speed FROM metrics
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Normalized Binance lead',NULL::double precision FROM markets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Convergence speed',NULL::double precision FROM markets
)
SELECT time,metric,value FROM series
ORDER BY time,CASE metric WHEN 'Normalized Binance lead' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
